}}'''Coulin''' was the Master of Arms in [[Tar Valon]] and a [[Warder]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Coulin}}

== Activities ==
He helped to train [[Gawyn Trakand]] and [[Galad Damodred]] during their time in the [[White Tower]]. He was killed by Gawyn during the [[White Tower Schism]].{{ref/book|4|47}}
